status: PROPOSED evaluation freeze (DRAFT, written 2026-10-23, nothing run). The owner freezes it: copy this file to pr6_ecm33_eval_freeze.json (same folder), set "frozen": true, set owner_signature, change any PROPOSAL not accepted, commit. pr6_ecm33_eval_extract.sbatch, pr6_ecm33_eval_search.sbatch and pr6_ecm33_eval_report.py refuse a missing or unfrozen file; the report also refuses unless every result file records the sha256 of the signed file. Decisions 1 to 5 of 2026-10-23 are applied (list decided_by_owner_2026-10-23); every key listed under proposals is still a PROPOSAL for the owner, not a decision.
target: frozen custom Ecm33 'all' model (data/custom_models/ecm33_all_2026-10-23), report-only, on an independent held-out set

custom_model.cutoff_kind: full-sequence score threshold, equivalent to hmmsearch -T 29.6; the job keeps hits down to the floor 0.0 and the report applies 29.6 (the build did the same); scores below 29.6 are descriptive near-misses and retune nothing
custom_model.note: nothing is retuned: the cutoff and the model are the frozen ones of the build (extra calls 4 of 32,491 proteome proteins, hard-negative rates 0 in every group)

test_set.unit: one UniRef50 cluster; the test sequence is the cluster representative (UniRef50 FASTA record), like the training members

cluster_attribute_rules.clade_fine: modal clade_fine of the cluster's proteins, ties alphabetical (2 clusters have two clades); decided 2026-10-23
cluster_attribute_rules.tier: T2 if ANY protein of the cluster is T2, else T3 (T1 has no new cluster); decided 2026-10-23
cluster_attribute_rules.subfamily: SF12 if any protein of the cluster is SF12, else the most frequent
cluster_attribute_rules.best_panther_evalue: smallest PANTHER E of the cluster's proteins

columns.headline: clusters with best PANTHER E <= 1e-10 AND separated from every training member by cluster30
columns.descriptive_1: clusters with best PANTHER E <= 1e-10, no separation applied

strata: evidence tier (T2_named, T3_panther_only; T1 has no new cluster)
PANTHER subfamily (SF12 kept apart from SF3)

separation.tool: mmseqs easy-cluster over the 481 training members plus the test representatives together
separation.rule: a test sequence in the same cluster as any training member is NOT separated: excluded from the headline, listed in separation.tsv, kept in descriptive_1 and descriptive_2
separation.training_members_faa_note: ecm33_members.faa of the build's extract job (sha256 from the build provenance, committed)
separation.limit: cluster membership is a heuristic (greedy set cover): a pair under the threshold can sit in different clusters; the rule is the freeze's cluster30 and is reported with that limit

searches.custom: hmmsearch -T 0.0 --noali with the model above; hit = full-sequence score >= 29.6
searches.pfam_ga: PF12454 (Pfam 38.2, hmmfetch -f by name Ecm33), hmmsearch --cut_ga
searches.iteration_alignment_seeded: jackhmmer -N 3 -E 1e-5 --incE 1e-5 --incdomE 1e-5 -Z 70198728 seeded by the build alignment of the all model (/bigdata/stajichlab/jstajich/projects/adhesionPred/_workdir/kiss_cluster_split/ecm33_build/all/none/train.aln.fa converted with esl-reformat stockholm): the build job's options plus -Z (owner decision 2026-10-23); all three iterative comparators use -Z 70198728
searches.phmmer_seed_only: phmmer -E 1e-5 --domE 1e-5 -Z 70198728 of the single sequence Q5AGC4 (data/controls/wall-fusion-kiss2019/sequences.faa)
searches.jackhmmer_seed_only: jackhmmer -N 3 -E 1e-5 --incE 1e-5 --incdomE 1e-5 -Z 70198728 of the single sequence Q5AGC4
searches.iteration_hit_rule: a test sequence is a hit when its tblout E-value is <= 1e-5 (the report constant ITER_E)

target_sets.hmmsearch_methods: the test representatives only (hits are scores; no E-value is used)
target_sets.iterative_and_phmmer_methods: the test representatives plus a background: the 161 shared hard negatives and the four kept proteomes (the build's iteration target). The training members are NOT in the target, so no seed-only search can use them. Only test ids are scored; background hits are not read.

searches.evalue_db_size_note: UniRef50 2025_03 sequence count (round 2 provenance): a seed-only E-value is the one a search of UniRef50 would give, as in the hyd1_like design (specs/2026-10-23-pr6-hyd1-like-design.md section 1, decision 10)

u.definition: u = test clusters missed by EVERY comparator above (the custom model is not a comparator)
u.rule: the verdict applies to the WHOLE HEADLINE SET only: the model passes when u >= min_u and it recovers at least ceil(u/2) of the u missed clusters; with u < 3 the verdict line says 'not testable (u < 3)'. Per-clade, per-tier, per-subfamily rows and the descriptive columns are DESCRIPTIVE, never a verdict. Every row prints n clusters, u, recovered of u, the plain per-comparator recall, and the exact two-sided 95 percent Clopper-Pearson interval for the recovered fraction and for each recall (3 decimals); at small u a wide interval is not a result
u.verdict_scope: whole headline set (PANTHER E <= 1e-10 and separated)
u.interval: exact two-sided 95 percent Clopper-Pearson, stdlib only, 3 decimals

false_hit_side: the build's: 4 extra calls of 32,491 proteome proteins and hard-negative call rate 0 in every group; the two true members among the shared negatives (P38248, Q4WNS8) are ignored by the build freeze. Not rerun here.
purity_check: descriptive, from candidates.tsv and the committed members.tsv: the training members versus the PANTHER-called UniRef50 clusters (expected 164 of 481 in none); no job
decided_by_owner_2026-10-22_and_23: custom model is report-only; nothing changes a call, tier, panel or narrow_ok

2. separation from the 481 training members by the shared-MMseqs2-cluster rule (cluster30: --min-seq-id 0.3 -c 0.5); no order-independent easy-search is added
3. -Z 70198728 on ALL THREE iterative comparators (iteration_alignment_seeded, phmmer_seed_only, jackhmmer_seed_only)
4. cluster attribute rules: clade = modal clade; tier = T2 if ANY protein of the cluster is T2; subfamily = SF12 if ANY protein is SF12; they only decide which row a cluster appears in
